svg.text: What is sticky, and what is fluid
The same sections grouped by what the rule does rather than who wrote it. Age separates the categories sharply. Amendment counts barely differ, so how often a rule is revised says
much less than how long ago it last was.
Box spans the middle half, line inside is the median, whiskers reach the 10th and 90th percentile. Every section past the 90th is drawn.

Source: eCFR full-text API, snapshot 2026-09-01. Interpretation is the publisher's own subject-group label; the other categories are inferred from section headings by keyword and 28% of sections match none of them.
